name: show-me-first
description: With a folder destination and a request to see the plan first, the skill shows the plan and does not save it.
prompt:
Plan my week, but show me first. Today is Monday 2026-11-02 at 09:00. weekly-planning.destination is ~/weekly-plans. No calendar tool, no tracker, no meetings. Work hours 09:00-18:00.
Tickets: ABC-3 Add retry metrics (6h).
Do not run any tool.
